intro.text: Hundreds of hidden drawers behind the wall tiles of an ancient library in Urithiru's basement, holding gems whose Stormlight hums out encoded messages.

items.text: Chasing a killer through the tower, Shallan led soldiers into the basement and found a room of ancient books, the store of knowledge Jasnah had hoped Urithiru would hold. The books had decayed so far that they crumbled to dust at a touch.

Once the debris was cleared, Navani made the room a centre for scholars. There Renarin made a tile pop out, revealing a drawer with an oddly cut ruby. When Jasnah infused it, Shallan and Pattern found that its vibrations carried a message. Renarin then pushed Stormlight into the wall, and every tile opened onto a hidden drawer.
